outlook.method: Theil-Sen trend + Mann-Kendall test on 2001-2024 yearly data, extended to 2035 with an 80% prediction range. Where there is no clear trend, the 2001-2024 average is projected. Statistical extrapolation, not a climate-model forecast.

consequences.headline: Pigeon pea fits 7 points worse by 2035
consequences.detail: If today's trends continue: Pigeon pea 65 → 58; Green gram 65 → 61; Cowpea 65 → 61 (crop match out of 100).
consequences.action: Build the rotation around crops whose match holds up.

consequences.headline: +0.7 °C warmer on average by 2035
consequences.detail: The yearly average moves from 27.4 °C to about 28.1 °C. Most recommended crops stay inside their temperature range.
consequences.action: Watch heat stress in cool-climate crops; earlier sowing helps.

consequences.headline: About 24% more rain by 2035
consequences.detail: Yearly rain trends from about 3,036 mm to 3,758 mm. More water, but also more waterlogging on heavy soil.
consequences.action: Keep drains open; raised beds help crops that hate wet feet.
